etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From French équanimité, from Latin aequanimitās (“calmness, equanimity”), from aequus (“even; calm; fair”) + animus (“mind, soul”) + -itās. By surface analysis, equ- +‎ anim(us) +‎ -ity.
senses: The state of being calm, stable and composed, especially under stress.
